recipes.name: Harvest Sheet-Pan Chicken with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, trimmed of excess fat and lightly pounded to a relatively even thickness
½ teaspoon ground black pepper divided
4 cups Brussels sprouts trimmed and halved (quarter if very large), about 1 pound
1 large sweet potato peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1 medium red onion cut into 3/4-inch pieces
1 medium Granny smith apple peeled, cored, and cut into rough 1-inch pieces
recipes.method: sheet pan / oven roast at 425F

recipes.name: Peruvian Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs with Green Sauce
ingredients: salt and freshly ground black pepper
recipes.method: sheet pan / oven roast at 400F
recipes.notes: Ingredients split in source into 'For the chicken' (first 11 lines) and 'For the sauce' (last 8 lines). Published nutrition covers the chicken only, not the green sauce.

recipes.name: Parmesan Garlic Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 ½ pounds baby potatoes (cut into 1 ½ inch pieces)
1 pound fresh green beans (trimmed and cut in half)
recipes.method: sheet pan / oven roast at 425F

recipes.name: Senegalese Chicken Mafe (Peanut Stew)
ingredients: ½ cup (64g) ground peanuts or peanut butter powder
3-4 cups (700-840ml) broth chicken or beef (reserved from boiling)
1 pound (450g) vegetables or more (potatoes, sweet potatoes, carrots, etc.)
1 whole scotch bonnet, habanero or ½ teaspoon cayenne (optional)
recipes.method: soup pot / simmer braise
recipes.notes: Source lets the cook choose beef or chicken; use chicken for this run.

recipes.name: Senegalese Chicken Yassa (Lemon Onion Chicken)
ingredients: 2½-3 pounds (1-1½kg) skin-on chicken, cut into pieces (thighs, legs, or breast)
salt and black pepper to taste (¾-1 teaspoon of salt per pound is average)
4 cloves garlic, minced and divided (half to season the chicken and the other half for the sauce)
1 tablespoon (12g) chicken bouillon powder, divided (half to season the chicken and the other half for the sauce)
2 lemons, one for the chicken and the other for the sauce
1 tablespoon (15g) neutral-flavored cooking oil (canola, sunflower seed, and avocado oil are good choices)
2 tablespoons (30g) Dijon mustard (any whole-grain or stone-ground mustard)
1 cup (240ml) chicken stock (or a cup of water and a teaspoon of bouillon powder)
1 Scotch bonnet pepper (or cayenne pepper adjusted to taste)
recipes.method: skillet / stovetop simmer

recipes.name: Peri Peri Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 1½ cups Uncooked rice I use golden sella basmati rice
2 bell peppers I use red and green
A handful of coriander aka cilantro or use as needed
recipes.method: one pot skillet / stovetop simmer

recipes.name: Kuku Paka (Swahili Coconut Chicken Curry)
ingredients: 4 chicken thigh fillets, skin-on and bone-in (~250g/8oz each)
2 tbsp coconut oil (or vegetable, canola or other plain oil)
1 tsp pure chilli powder or cayenne pepper
2 tbsp lemon juice (sub apple cider vinegar)
Basmati rice or other rice, and/or flatbreads or roti
recipes.method: dutch oven / heavy pot sear then simmer
recipes.notes: Source servings listed as 4-6; midpoint 5 used. Published nutrition is calculated at 6 servings.

recipes.name: Cape Malay Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 tsp chili flakes, or fresh hot peppers to taste
2 tsp fennel, ground, or 4 tsp whole fennel seeds
14 oz can crushed tomatoes, or diced tomatoes
recipes.method: pot with lid / simmer braise

recipes.name: Zanzibar-Style One Pot Chicken Pilau
ingredients: 2 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (or 2 tsp each minced)
½–1 Knorr chicken bouillon cube, to taste
Optional: 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, for deglazing
Optional: Lemon wedge and parsley to garnish and serve
recipes.method: dutch oven / large pot, covered simmer
recipes.notes: Source servings listed as 4-6; midpoint 5 used.

recipes.name: Nigerian Chicken Suya Bowls
ingredients: ½-1 tablespoon (2-3g) cayenne (depending on heat preference)
4 tablespoons (64g) peanut butter or groundnut paste
recipes.method: oven bake at 450F on sheet pan, broiler finish
recipes.notes: Source is the suya chicken itself; bowl components (rice/veg) are not in the source ingredient list.

recipes.name: One Pot Caribbean Jerk Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 1 sprig fresh thyme (or 1 teaspoon dried thyme)
1 15.5-ounce can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained
recipes.method: oven-proof skillet / dutch oven, sear then oven bake at 350F

recipes.name: Jamaican Brown Stew Chicken
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste (see notes)
1 teaspoon (2g) fresh thyme (¼-½ teaspoon dried thyme)
1 teaspoon (2g) fresh thyme (¼-½ teaspoon dried thyme)
1 teaspoon (5g) hot sauce (or sub chili sauce)
2 small bell peppers, sliced (red or green)
recipes.method: cast-iron skillet / brown then simmer
recipes.notes: Serving count of 10 corresponds to the 10 cut chicken pieces.

recipes.name: Trinidad Chicken Pelau
ingredients: ¼ teaspoon salt or creole seasoning
1 sprig fresh thyme or 1 teaspoon dried thyme
15.5 oz. can pigeon beans rinsed and drained
3 ½ cups or more chicken broth or water
Salt and fresh ground pepper to taste
recipes.method: dutch oven / caramelize sugar, brown, simmer
recipes.notes: Source servings listed as 6-7; 6 used (midpoint 6.5 rounded down). Ingredients split into 'Chicken Marinate' (first 8 lines) and 'Trinidad Pelau' (rest).

recipes.name: Puerto Rican Pollo Guisado
ingredients: 1.5 lb chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
recipes.method: dutch oven braise
recipes.notes: Servings stated as 4 x 2-cup servings.

recipes.name: Haitian Poulet en Sauce
ingredients: 5 Chicken Legs; the skin on or off
5 Chicken Thighs; the skin on or off
4 Tbsp Canola Oil; Vegetable oil, or peanut oil will work.
4 Cloves Garlic; crushed or smashed in mortar and pestle
2 Lemons Or Limes juice squeezed then reserve the lemons or limes
6 tablespoon tomato paste; Or half of a 12 Oz. can
1 Bell Pepper; Sliced and seeds removed. You can also mix the bell peppers for a vibrant color.
1 Medium Yellow Onion; Cut in half: Half sliced and half diced
recipes.method: dutch oven / heavy pot sear then simmer
recipes.notes: Ingredients split into 'For The Chicken' (first 4 lines) and 'For The Haitian Chicken Stew' (rest). Published protein of 12g looks low relative to 10 chicken pieces over 4 servings; treat the source nutrition with caution.

recipes.name: Kadai Chicken (Chicken Karahi)
ingredients: ½ kg (1.1 lbs) boneless chicken (1 inch pieces or ¾ kg (1.6 lbs) bone-in chicken, curry-cut)
¾ cup (100 grams) onions chopped finely
1¼ cup (300 grams) tomato puree (2 medium tomatoes pureed)
½ to ¾ teaspoon salt (adjust to taste)
½ teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder (use up to 1 teaspoon for heat)
½ to 1 teaspoon garam masala (adjust to taste, I use ¾ tsp)
3 tablespoons heavy cream/ yogurt (or 10 cashews pureed, read notes)
2 to 3 black pepper corn (or ⅛ teaspoon crushed pepper)
recipes.method: kadai / wok skillet saute and simmer
recipes.notes: Final 7 lines are the kadai masala spice blend, ground fresh in the source.

recipes.name: Chicken Madras Curry
ingredients: 1.1 lbs (½ kg) grams boneless chicken breasts/ thighs
1 tablespoon ginger garlic grated/ crushed (½ tbsp. each)
2 tablespoons coriander leaves (handful leaves fine chopped)
½ to 1 teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder (omit for low heat)
3 tablespoons ghee (divided or use ½ ghee & ½ oil)
½ inch (4 grams) ginger (peeled and sliced)
1¾ cups (200 grams) tomatoes sliced or diced tomatoes
⅓ cup (35 to 50 grams) carrots sliced
⅓ cup (35 to 50 grams) red bell pepper sliced (optional)
1½ cups water or broth (divided, 1 + ½ cup hot water)
½ to 1 teaspoon Kashmiri chili powder (adjust to taste or omit for low heat)
½ to 1½ tablespoon tamarind paste (or chutney or 1 tsp concentrate or lemon juice, adjust to taste)
½ to 1 tablespoon sugar or jaggery (adjust to taste, omit to use chutney)
½ cup coconut milk (optional, at room temperature)
recipes.method: skillet / pot saute and simmer
recipes.notes: Ingredients split into 'To marinate' (first 8 lines) and 'To make the sauce' (rest).

recipes.name: Chicken Rogan Josh
ingredients: 5 tablespoons mustard oil (or ghee or any other cooking oil)
1 kilogram skinless bone-in chicken (cut into 1 and ½ inch pieces, rinsed)
1-2 inch piece of ratanjot (for tempering, optional)
recipes.method: pressure cooker / instant pot (stovetop pot works too)
recipes.notes: Nutrition box re-verified on a second fetch: 500kcal, 32g protein.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry Chicken
ingredients: 4 – 6 tbsp Thai Green Curry Paste (Maesri best) OR
1 cup (250ml) chicken or vegetable broth, low sodium
6 kaffir lime leaves, torn in half
350 g/12 oz chicken thigh, skinless boneless, sliced
Green or red chillies slices, optional
recipes.method: skillet / heavy-based pot simmer
recipes.notes: Published protein of 7g is implausibly low for the chicken content; source nutrition appears to exclude the chicken or rice. Verify downstream.

recipes.name: Panang Chicken Curry
ingredients: 700g/ 1.4 lb whole raw prawns/shrimp (ie shell on), medium ~8cm / 3″long – Note 1
350g / 12 oz boneless, skinless chicken thighs , cut into 7mm/ 1/3" slices
1 1/2 cups chicken stock/broth , low-sodium (not fish/seafood – Note 2)
2/3 cup dried Chinese chillies (not Thai!) (24 x 6cm/2.5" long, 1/2 cup (15g) once deseeded chopped) – Note 3
2 lemongrass stems , finely grated (2 x 20cm/8" lengths) – Note 4
1 tbsp galangal, finely grated (~1.5cm / 0.6" piece) – Note 5
1 1/2 tbsp shrimp paste in bean oil – Note 6
1/2 tsp each ground coriander, cumin, nutmeg
1 tbsp (packed) finely sliced kaffir lime leaves (~ 6 leaves) – Note 7
1 1/4 cups coconut cream , full-fat (standard Aus 270ml small can ok)
200g/7oz green beans , trimmed, cut in half (~1 1/2 cups)
Thai basil leaves , 3 leaves per serving – Note 8
recipes.method: large deep frying pan / skillet, fry paste then simmer
recipes.notes: Source servings listed as 4-5; the nutrition line states 'per serving assuming 5 servings, excluding rice', so 5 used. Numeric calorie/protein values could not be read from the page on two fetches, so nutrition is null. Protein is a choose-ONE between prawns and chicken; use the chicken line (350g chicken thighs). The prawn stock line applies only to the prawn version.

recipes.name: Massaman Chicken Curry
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. olive oil, coconut oil or vegetable oil
1 lb. chicken breasts, chopped, or substitute shrimp or tofu
2 medium gold potatoes, (or russet potatoes), peeled and chopped into small pieces
2 carrots, peeled and sliced into 1/8-inch thick slices
1 4 oz can massaman curry paste or homemade
1 Tbsp. peanut butter, smooth or crunchy
1/2 c. chopped roasted peanuts, for garnish
recipes.method: large pot / stovetop simmer

recipes.name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow)
ingredients: 225g / 7oz chicken thigh fillets, skinless boneless, cut into bite size pieces
1 cup Thai basil leaves, loosely packed (Holy Basil if you can find it)
1 birds eye or Thai chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
1 tsp dark soy sauce (or all purpose)
recipes.method: wok / high-heat stir fry
recipes.notes: Published nutrition excludes the rice.

recipes.name: Thai Drunken Noodles with Chicken (Pad Kee Mao)
ingredients: 2 birds eye chilli or Thai chillies , deseeded, very finely chopped (Note 2)
200 g /7oz chicken thighs , cut into bite size pieces (breast ok too)
1 cup Thai or Thai Holy Basil leaves (sub regular basil, Note 3)
recipes.method: wok / large heavy skillet, high-heat stir fry
recipes.notes: Source servings listed as 2-3; published nutrition is calculated at 3 servings, so 3 used. Ingredients split into Noodles / Stir Fry / Sauce sections.

recipes.name: Thai Cashew Chicken
ingredients: 10 oz boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into thin pieces
½ small onion, cut into pieces
½ small red bell pepper, cut into pieces
½ small green bell pepper, cut into pieces
1 tablespoon sugar, or more to taste
recipes.method: skillet / wok stir fry

recipes.name: Chicken Bulgogi Rice Bowls
ingredients: 450 g chicken thigh (1 pound), (I used boneless skinless thigh, but you can use other chicken cuts of your choice.)
1/4 cup Sprite (alternatively, 7 Up or other carbonated lemon-lime soda could be used.)
recipes.method: skillet / stir fry over medium-high heat
recipes.notes: Source is the bulgogi chicken only; rice and bowl toppings are not in the source ingredient list.

recipes.name: Vietnamese Ginger Chicken (Ga Kho Gung)
ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings (or any cut that you prefer)
50 g / 0.11 lb ginger (pounded or finely sliced)
recipes.method: wok / skillet sear then simmer
recipes.notes: Source page is titled Honey Glazed Ginger Chicken (Ga Kho Gung).

recipes.name: Vietnamese Chicken Curry (Ca Ri Ga)
ingredients: 6 tbsp tumeric powder (or enough to cover all the chicken)
5 L / 21 US cup chicken and pork stock
15 curry leaves (we get it from the local Asian supermarket)
600 g / 1.5 lb taro (peeled and cut into large chunks)
600 g / 1.5 lb sweet potato (peeled and cut into large chunks)
230 g / 0.5 lb curry sauce (we get it from the Asian grocery store; or use 3 tbsp curry powder instead)
recipes.method: soup pot / stovetop simmer (aromatics flash-fried in a wok first)
recipes.notes: Very large party-scale batch (5 L stock). Downstream scaling will likely be needed.

recipes.name: Halal Cart Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless, skinless, chicken thighs, cut into 1-2 inch pieces
2 cups long grain basmati rice, washed and drained
1/4 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste
1/8 teaspoon black pepper, plus more to taste
recipes.method: skillet for chicken plus pot for rice (stovetop)
recipes.notes: Source sections: For the Chicken (10 lines), For the Yellow Rice (7), For the White Sauce (6), To Serve (8).

recipes.name: Chicken Maqluba (Palestinian Upside-Down Rice)
ingredients: 1 medium globe eggplant trimmed and cut into 3/4-inch rounds
11 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided, plus more for sheet pans
1 large head cauliflower (2½ pounds), trimmed, cored, and cut into florets
3 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, or a mix of thighs and breasts
1 – 2 vine-ripened medium tomatoes, sliced into 1/2-inch rounds
recipes.method: large deep pot (8-quart) layered and inverted; vegetables roasted on sheet pans first

recipes.name: Musakhan (Sumac Chicken and Caramelized Onions)
ingredients: 6 chicken legs, bone-in, skin on (if you like, divide the legs to thighs and drumsticks. You can also use chicken breast pieces, if you prefer.)
Extra virgin olive oil (I used Greek Private Reserve EVOO)
Extra virgin olive oil (Greek Private Reserve EVOO again)
Toasted pine nuts, about 1/3 cup or more to your liking
6 flatbread such as Taboon bread, Greek pita bread, or naan
recipes.method: oven roast (roasting pan) plus skillet for the onions
recipes.notes: No nutrition box published. Source sections: For Spice Mixture (6 lines), For Chicken (5), For Flatbread (8). The spice mixture makes more than the recipe uses.

recipes.name: Peruvian Pollo Saltado
ingredients: 1.5 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts, thinly sliced against the grain
½ red bell pepper, sliced into strips
½ green bell pepper, sliced into strips
½ yellow bell pepper, cut into strips
recipes.method: large skillet or wok, high-heat stir fry
recipes.notes: Source servings listed as 4-6; midpoint 5 used. Published nutrition is calculated at 6 servings.

recipes.name: Ecuadorian Seco de Pollo
ingredients: 4 to 5 lbs of assorted chicken pieces
2 tsp ground achiote or annatto can also use paprika (if you can't find ground achiote you can use the seeds, they will need to be simmered in the oil until they release their color)
1 to 2 cups of beer or chicken broth/wine/chicha
1 cup of naranjilla lulo juice, can use the frozen concentrate (can be replaced with fresh orange juice as an alternative)
2 bell peppers seeds removed and cut into chunks
Optional: 1 aji or hot pepper jalapeno or serrano, can also use chili powder
1 bunch cilantro reserve some to chop finely to add at the end
1 bunch parsley leaves only, reserve some to chop finely and add at the end
2 tsp dry oregano or 2-3 fresh oregano sprigs
recipes.method: dutch oven / pot braise, brown then simmer about an hour
recipes.notes: No nutrition box published.

recipes.name: Brazilian Galinhada (Chicken and Saffron Rice)
ingredients: 1 kg sobrecoxas de frango com osso e pele cerca de 4 a 5
½ colher de chá de pimenta moída
½ colher de chá de cominho moído
2 colheres de sopa de óleo vegetal
2 xícaras de arroz branco de grão longo parboilizado
½ xícara de chá vinho branco
3 xícaras de chá caldo de galinha líquido
1 colher de chá de extrato de tomate
3 to tomates grandes em cubos sem pele e sementes removidas
¾ xícara de chá ervilhas frescas ou congeladas
2 colheres de sopa de cebola verde picada ou salsa
recipes.method: large pot / panela, stovetop (pressure cooker variant given)
recipes.notes: The recipe card served on this URL is PORTUGUESE ONLY - confirmed on a second fetch asking specifically for an English card. Ingredient lines are transcribed verbatim in Portuguese and will need translation downstream. Servings published as '5 pessoas'. Line 1 = 1 kg bone-in skin-on chicken thighs (about 4-5).

recipes.name: Georgian Chicken Chakhokhbili
recipes.method: skillet / pan, fry then simmer
recipes.notes: Blog-style post with no recipe card: servings NOT published (set to 0) and no nutrition published. Ingredient list is complete and transcribed verbatim including the source's typo 'depenednet'. 1 kilo of chicken suggests roughly 5-6 servings but the source does not say so.
